name: great-cto
description: Engineering process as a plugin: specialist agents, skills, commands and a local board for Claude Code.

plugins.name: great_cto
plugins.description: You already have the agent. This is everything around it. great_cto runs Claude Code as a pipeline of 70 specialist agents — an independent model checks each stage before the next builds on it, spending caps refuse rather than warn, and three decisions stay yours: what gets built, how, and whether it ships.
